summary: Pharvaris N.V. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held on June 26, 2026. Shareholders approved routine items: adoption of the 2025 Dutch statutory annual accounts, appointment of PricewaterhouseCoopers Accountants N.V. as auditor for 2026, discharge of directors from liability for 2025, extension of board authorization to acquire shares, and re-appointment of non-executive director Dr. Margareta Elisabeth Björk. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, activist campaign, or strategic transaction was announced. The filing is a standard corporate governance update with no special-situation event.
